title: Assignment 1: Foundations of Quantum Computation
subtitle: Synthesizing Chapters 1–6: Classical, Reversible, Probabilistic, and Multi-Qubit Systems
intro: This assignment brings together the foundational principles, state updates, configuration trajectories, and circuit mechanisms developed across the first six chapters of the course. Every problem derives its conclusions from first principles using only the configurations, computational paths, state vectors, and operators introduced in the lectures.
